newsitem.title: CANADA: Wood Gundy initiates Hyal as a buy.
newsitem.headline: Wood Gundy initiates Hyal as a buy.

text.p: CIBC/Wood Gundy initiated coverage of Hyal Pharmaceutical Corp with a buy recommendation and a speculative price range of 7.75 to 20 over the next year, Hyal spokeswoman Barbara Kay said on Monday.

"Recent negative events have cast shadows on Hyal's ability to license its technology to large pharmaceutical companies, causing a large drop in share price," said a report by analyst Gus De Franco. "We believe the magnitude of the share drop is unwarranted and recommend purchase."
In early August Hyal said its topical gel for relieving osteoarthritis pain performed poorly in part of its testing.
On Monday, Hyal rose 0.70 to 5.70 in moderate trading on the Toronto Stock Exchange.
On Nasdaq, the stock gained 0.50 to 4-3/16 in light trading.

Hyal saw its stock tumble to a year low of 4.10 in Toronto in September. The company had added in August that its completion of regulatory submissions in North America for the gel, called Hyanalgese-D, might be delayed for at least 12 months. The shares hit a year high of 18 in early June.
Analyst De Franco focused on the potential of Hyal's Solarese, a product to treat sun-damaged skin before cancer develops. The condition is called actinic keratosis.
Hyal expects to file for regulatory approval for Solarese before year end in six countries, including the United States and Canada.
Hyal's management said it expected to sign a licensing deal for the product before the end of 1996.
